bagPolicy.summary: One small handbag or backpack per person is allowed. Suitcases and large backpacks are not permitted.
allowed: One small handbag or small backpack per person
bagPolicy.note: Bags must stay with you at all times, and random bag searches may take place at the main doors. Some events have extra security measures, so check the event page.

parking.note: No specific parking options, pricing, or tips are mentioned on the page.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Usher Hall's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Bar and refreshment service varies by performance and building setup. Review the current Usher Hall event listing before arrival.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by Usher Hall, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Usher Hall's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Usher Hall. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Usher Hall. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.

glance.label: Bags
glance.value: One small handbag or backpack per person is allowed
